notes.title: Fixed a bug that prevented progress
notes.content:
Fixed an incorrect position of a item required for progression that could not be obtained due to the specifications.
Also, I have confirmed that it is possible to clear from that stage to the end.

I apologize for the time it took to recognize the issue and for the inconvenience caused to all users.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and New Action
notes.content:
Fixed physics between objects.
Support Keyboard Input for jump.
Added Jump Pad.
Added some SEs.

notes.title: Added puzzle action elements
notes.content:
This update has many changes.


Added Jump action.
Added Ledge grab action.
Renewed stages as Puzzle action game.
Added some new objects.
and other small changes.

notes.title: Optimized for controller input and horizontal screen
notes.content:
The changes are as follows.

* Improved the UI.
* Adjusted the difficulty level.

Please confirm that the version number on the upper right of the title screen is 22.02.03 or higher.
